audit_items.proof_trace: BeaconProposerIndexAtSlot violates the invariant by recomputing proposer indices (lines 358-371) for past epochs and epochs beyond next, instead of exclusively using proposer_lookahead. Additionally, beaconProposerIndexAtSlotFulu uses a 2-epoch sliding window with epoch-dependent indexing (current: slot%spe, next: spe+slot%spe) rather than the spec-required uniform index of slot%SLOTS_PER_EPOCH.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker queries proposer index for a past epoch (e < stateEpoch) or future epoch (e > stateEpoch+1). The function bypasses lookahead and recomputes using Seed() and ComputeProposerIndex() (lines 334-371), producing results inconsistent with the cached lookahead array, potentially causing fork divergence if validators use different code paths.
